refs.title: dartkomnitibe/solana-meme-tool
refs.why: Launch on pump.fun. Coordinate wallets. Snipe new pools. Mirror wallets. Run limit orders. Score counterparties. All from one Next.js control room.

plan.borrow: The 'control room' aesthetic and density from dartkomnitibe/solana-meme-tool, adapted into a single-file HTML terminal using the FEELESS PLASMA palette and Motion for React to replicate the 'live desk' feel without Next.js.
steps: Extract the 'control room' layout and data density from the Solana Meme Tool reference.
Apply the FEELESS PLASMA palette (night mode) and Unbounded/Sora fonts to create the terminal background and typography.
Implement a 'Live Ticker' component for SOL price updates using a simulated WebSocket stream (since no API key exists).
Build a 'Community Map' component using Leaflet.js with markers for EMBER meetup locations.
Construct the 'Connect Wallet' and 'Launch List' forms using shadcn-style inputs and a 'Copy Address' utility.
plan.risks: No real Solana RPC connection means the SOL price will be simulated; the map requires a Leaflet API key (will use a placeholder or open-source tile server); the 'Connect Wallet' is purely frontend visual (no actual wallet connection logic).
